features.name: Bloodied Fury
features.text: While Bloodied, Adam has Advantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.text: Adam can't shape-shift.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: Adam has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Adam makes two Slam attacks and uses Crush or Throw.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18) from one of two hands.

features.name: Crush
features.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature Grappled by Adam. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition. While Restrained, the target is suffocating.

features.name: Throw
features.text: Adam throws a creature Grappled by him to a space he can see within 30 feet of himself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Violent Leap
features.text: Adam spends 10 feet of movement to jump to a space within 40 feet that contains one or more Medium or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in Adam's destination space. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: The target moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

features.name: Bolster Inventions
features.text: At the end of each of Viktra's turns, each of her Construct allies in a 5-foot Emanation originating from Viktra gains 5 Temporary Hit Points. This trait doesn't function if Viktra has the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Viktra dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Mordenheim Kinetics.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Viktra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Viktra makes two Lightning Rod attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Syringe.

features.name: Lightning Rod
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Syringe
features.text:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature Viktra can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target suffers one of the following effects (Viktra's choice). The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute:

- **Corrosive Serum.** The target takes 10 (4d4) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and its Speed decreases by 10 feet.
- **Deadly Serum.** The target takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it can't regain Hit Points.
- **Mind-Altering Serum.** The target takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration.

spellcasting.text: Viktra casts Animate Objects, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Berserk
features.text:
Whenever the created starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the created goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the created attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the created attacks an object. Once the created goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

The created's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk created, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the created must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the created ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

features.name: Malfunction
features.text:
The created randomly creates one of the following effects (roll 1d4):

- **1: Insect Hive.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet. Failure: The creature takes 13 (3d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
- **2: Melting Plastic.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 13 (3d8) Fire damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and the target can take either an action or Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only
- **3: Electrical Discharge.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage
- **4: Haywire.** The created makes two Slam attacks and goes berserk. It rolls for the Berserk trait each round, whether or not it is Bloodied, for 1 minute.
